reconcile.note: Adam Clarke closes the regnal gap with a coregency, since Jehoash shared the throne with his dying father Jehoahaz two years before his sixteen-year reign properly began.

sides.snippet: Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, [and reigned] seventeen years.
sides.verseText: In the three and twentieth year of Joash the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, Jehoahaz the son of Jehu began to reign over Israel in Samaria, [and reigned] seventeen years.

sides.snippet: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria
sides.verseText: In the thirty-seventh year of Joash king of Judah began Jehoash the son of Jehoahaz to reign over Israel in Samaria, [and reigned] sixteen years.
